DiscoveryCall.description: Local child/parent IPC: no worker credentials, shell strings or filesystem paths.

DiscoveryDraft.description: The model selects a prefix and writes expectations; code owns commands and evidence IDs.

DiscoveryDraftCheck.description: Use an action number at the model boundary; the recorder resolves checkpoint identities.

DiscoveryEngine.description: Discovery-only protocol. Absence on historical payloads means the legacy custom loop.
